messages:
maya: Heads up — last-minute change: Amy will present from home, not on stage. Can we confirm remote mics + slide capture are good? I just saw a warning on the recorder.

devon (stream): On it. Recorder threw a frame-drop warning 30s ago. Obs reports dropped frames but encoder still up. Trying a quick restart on capture box.

kevin: I can swap camera A -> camera B and route Amy's RTMP feed to the stage screen. @devon do you want me to cut or fade? :fade: 

devon (stream): Fade please. Also plz patch the preview to the live caption loop — last time captions lagged behind audio by ~3s.

maya: Thanks. Anna, can you DM Amy the backup dial-in and ask her to mute unless speaking? We need to avoid echo on the stage mics.

anna (ops): Will do. Sending: "Zoom link (backup): https://zoom.redwood/example — mute on entry, unmute when prompted." 

stream-bot: Deploy check: encoder-02 health=OK, obs-capture status=RESTARTING, captions-service latency=2.8s

kevin: Camera switch done. Ran `obs-cli scene switch "RemoteSpeaker"` and confirmed Tally green.

maya: Nice. Devon — any persistent errors after the restart?

devon (stream): Restart cleared the dropped frames but found a permission error mounting the NFS recorder path. Log: ```Error: EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/mnt/recorder/tmp' at Object.mkdirSync (fs.js:...)``` Trying remount with correct uid.

kevin: If NFS is flaky we can fallback to local SSD spool for the recording segment. Switching spool now.

devon (stream): Switched to local spool, recording resumed. Pushing the partial file to S3 after the meeting.

amy (ceo): Thanks team! If the audio mix is a little thin, bump my mic gain +3dB when I start. I'll keep questions short for the Q&A. :sparkles:

maya: Copy that. Final checklist: captions sync checked, camera switched, recorder on local spool, backup zoom sent. We should be good for the handoff in 90s.

kevin: Doing a quick sound check on Amy's feed now — levels look +2 to +4dB, applying +3dB as requested.

devon (stream): All set. I'll monitor for 10m post-meeting to make sure uploads and captions finalize.

maya: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post a short on-stage cue 30s before Amy starts.
